replacement_units.main_photos: preserve count, role and layer order; no silent merge or removal
replacement_units.nested_photos: outer photograph is one input unless a distinct designed inner replacement window is supported by evidence; unresolved units block automatic construction
replacement_units.external_scene: full canvas scene used as the main photo is a slot; scene around an album is not silently changed; ambiguous scene role blocks automatic construction

fixed_elements.preserve: requires an isolated asset; retaining flattened old photo pixels is not preservation
fixed_elements.reference_generate: only individually allowed approximate decorations; never customer photos, meaningful text or critical protected content

quality.probe_scope: window visibility only; no production approval
quality.approximate_pass: all hard requirements pass and approximation list is nonempty
